components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 58px; display: inline-flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 30px; padding: 0 24px; background: var(--sand, #cbb181); color: var(--ink, #151311); font: 600 13px/1.2 var(--sans, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; transition: transform .25s ease, background .25s ease; } .ds-icon { width: 17px; height: 17px; flex: 0 0 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); background: #dfc89d; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c58a73; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.css: .ds-practice-record { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 70px minmax(190px,.8fr) minmax(220px,1fr) auto; gap: 24px; align-items: center; min-height: 164px; padding: 30px 20px 30px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(21,19,17,.2)); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(21,19,17,.2)); background: var(--paper, #f6f2e9); color: var(--ink, #151311); transition: background .35s ease; } .ds-practice-record:hover { background: rgba(203,177,129,.11); } .ds-practice-code { color: var(--wine, #581827); font: 600 11px/1.2 var(--sans, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif); letter-spacing: .14em; } .ds-practice-record h3 { margin: 0; font: 400 36px/1 var(--display, 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif); letter-spacing: -.025em; transition: color .25s ease; } .ds-practice-record:hover h3 { color: var(--wine, #581827); } .ds-practice-record p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted, #675f58); font: 400 16px/1.65 var(--sans, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-practice-record a { display: inline-flex; gap: 15px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--wine, #581827); color: var(--wine, #581827); font: 600 12px/1.2 var(--sans, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; } .ds-icon { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: transform .25s ease; } .ds-practice-record a:hover .ds-icon { transform: translate(3px,-3px); } .ds-practice-record a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c58a73; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-header { min-height: 76px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 30px; padding: 0 28px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(30,26,24,.12); background: rgba(244,239,230,.97); color: var(--ink, #151311); box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(30,26,24,.08); } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; color: inherit; font: 600 11px/1.2 var(--sans, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif); letter-spacing: .11em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-brand small { display: block; margin-top: 5px; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: .17em; opacity: .68; } .ds-monogram { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,.045); font: 500 16px/1 var(--display, 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif); letter-spacing: -.04em; } .ds-header nav { display: flex; gap: 30px; } .ds-header nav a { border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; color: inherit; font: 600 12px/1.2 var(--sans, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .25s ease; } .ds-header nav a:hover { border-color: currentColor; } .ds-header a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c58a73; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Opaque Mobile Header
components.description: The stable charcoal mobile header, offset below the top safe area with a 44px menu target.
components.html: SMEstudio Jurídico
components.css: .ds-mobile-header { min-height: calc(72px + env(safe-area-inset-top)); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: env(safe-area-inset-top) 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); background: var(--ink, #151311); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.14); } .ds-mobile-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: inherit; font: 600 11px/1.2 var(--sans, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif); letter-spacing: .11em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-mobile-monogram { width: 38px; height: 38px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; font: 500 14px/1 var(--display, 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif); } .ds-menu-control { width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 8px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-menu-control span { display: block; width: 26px; height: 1px; margin: 6px 0; background: currentColor; transition: transform .3s ease; } .ds-menu-control[aria-expanded="true"] span:first-child { transform: translateY(3.5px) rotate(45deg); } .ds-menu-control[aria-expanded="true"] span:last-child { transform: translateY(-3.5px) rotate(-45deg); } .ds-mobile-header a:focus-visible, .ds-menu-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c58a73; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-contact-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 120px 1fr auto; gap: 20px; align-items: center; min-height: 112px; padding: 20px 4px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.32); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.32); background: var(--ink, #151311); color: #fff; text-decoration: none; } .ds-contact-row span { color: var(--sand, #cbb181); font: 600 11px/1.2 var(--sans, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif); letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-contact-row strong { font: 400 30px/1.1 var(--display, 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif); } .ds-icon { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: transform .25s ease; } .ds-contact-row:hover .ds-icon { transform: translate(4px,-4px); } .ds-contact-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c58a73; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-contact-row:active { opacity: .82; }

components.css: .ds-whatsapp-mobile { position: fixed; z-index: 45; left: max(14px, env(safe-area-inset-left)); right: max(14px, env(safe-area-inset-right)); bottom: max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); min-height: 56px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 0 20px; transform: translateY(calc(100% + 30px)); opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none; background: #176b4d; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.28); font: 600 13px/1.2 var(--sans, 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; transition: transform .32s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), opacity .2s ease, visibility .2s ease; } .ds-whatsapp-mobile.is-active { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; visibility: visible; pointer-events: auto; } .ds-menu-open .ds-whatsapp-mobile { opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none; } .ds-icon { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-whatsapp-mobile:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c58a73; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
The visual world translates a legal case dossier into a calm contemporary landing page. A charcoal case cover establishes gravity; oxblood binding, ivory document paper, brass actions, indexing rules, tab-like metadata, and editorial typography make the information feel ordered rather than institutional. The mood is composed, exact, local, and quietly premium.

The system is deliberately factual. Refined but recognizable office photography acts as evidence, while restrained transitions and authored directional icons help the page settle and guide without delaying access to the consultation path. Decorative spectacle, generic courthouse imagery, and inflated markers of prestige have no role here.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal cover fields, oxblood binding, and warm ivory paper.
Newsreader editorial headlines paired with compact DM Sans metadata.
Hairline rules that index content instead of boxed cards.
Sharp rectangular actions and one circular monogram.
Muted-brass actions and a consistent authored SVG arrow system.
Real office photography, selectively desaturated and contrast-refined.
Quiet image-settle and reveal motion with a complete reduced-motion path.

rules.name: The Charcoal Frame Rule
rules.body: Charcoal owns the opening and closing cover fields; deep oxblood belongs to the studio chapter, while brighter wine is reserved for annotation and emphasis.

rules.name: The Evidence Green Rule
rules.body: Green belongs only to the fixed mobile WhatsApp action; all other conversion paths stay inside the charcoal, oxblood, paper, and brass world.

rules.name: The Editorial-to-Operational Rule
rules.body: Newsreader carries meaning and emphasis; DM Sans carries instructions, metadata, and action. Do not swap their roles.

rules.name: The Quiet Weight Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from scale, contrast, and spacing—not heavy serif weights. Display type remains regular.

rules.name: The Flat File Rule
rules.body: Content rests on paper or cover fields; never turn practice areas or office facts into floating rounded cards.

rules.name: The Single Seal Rule
rules.body: Circles belong to the monogram only; do not propagate pill shapes, circular icon buttons, or soft cards across the interface.

rules.name: The Contextual Persistence Rule
rules.body: The floating WhatsApp action appears only in the middle of the mobile journey: never beside the hero CTA, never over the contact section, and never behind an open menu.

dos: Do frame the page with charcoal, reserve deep oxblood for the studio, and use brass for action and archival emphasis.
Do keep practice-area labels and rows directly actionable through their area-specific WhatsApp messages.
Do use one-pixel rules, tracked metadata, and asymmetric split layouts to express the dossier idea.
Do preserve the real office photograph as evidence and keep motion calm, optional, and non-blocking.
Do use the authored 1.5px-stroke SVG external and down arrows consistently across actions and navigation cues.
Do keep the mobile header opaque, safe-area-aware, and synchronized with anchor and menu offsets.
Do show the floating WhatsApp action only when both the primary CTA and contact section are out of view, and hide it while navigation is open.
Do keep keyboard focus obvious and honor `prefers-reduced-motion` across every animation and transition.
donts: Don't use rounded cards, pill badges, gradients as decoration, or generic legal iconography.
Don't introduce gavels, scales of justice, marble courthouses, stock handshakes, or fabricated prestige imagery.
Don't use green outside the persistent mobile WhatsApp action.
Don't mix text glyph arrows, emoji, or third-party icon styles into the directional icon system.
Don't let the mobile header become transparent or reduce the menu control below its 44px square target.
Don't pin the floating WhatsApp action over the primary CTA, the contact section, an open menu, or a device safe area.
Don't add decorative animation that delays access to practice areas or consultation actions.
Don't imply credentials, outcomes, testimonials, addresses, schedules, or services that are not supported by product truth.
